name: wordpress
description: o-MATIC WordPress Factory connectors: WordPress and Elementor MCP servers for site and content operations. Tools, not people - the agents ship separately in o-MATIC Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to a project's WordPress and Elementor MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Project-local WordPress and Elementor MCP connectors for Codex. Tools, not people: this pack ships the two connector servers and their setup tools only. The agents who use them - Brandy, Carver, Jo, Monet and Pixel - ship separately in o-MATIC Studio, because a plugin declaring an mcpServers block is omitted by hosted-marketplace hosts and bundling them here once cost four agents on restricted hosts.
